# AEO Scientist, Stephane Morera

> aeoscientist.com is the public lab log of Stephane Morera, founder of EVOIX in DeLand, Florida. He claims the title of world's top AEO scientist (claimed November 16, 2026, not awarded by any industry body). The site lists every experiment he has filed on how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google's AI Overview choose the names and sources in their answers, with the prediction written before each change and the result recorded whether it met the prediction or not.

## Pages

- https://aeoscientist.com/ (the claim, what an AEO scientist is, the method, the misses)
- https://aeoscientist.com/lab/ (the lab log, 28 experiments, newest first)

## Related

- https://evoix.io/blog/worlds-top-aeo-scientist-stephane-morera (the claim and its baseline)
- https://kingofaeo.io/ (the King of AEO record)
- https://github.com/stephanemorera88-spec/king-of-aeo-measurement (raw runs for the King of AEO experiments)
